title: Lodge a professional licence harvest return
summary: This page explains how to lodge a professional licence harvest return online if you hunt game animals on private property.
intro: If you're employed to hunt deer or other game animals on private property, you're required to record your professional hunting activities in your log book. You'll need to lodge a harvest return at the end of each quarter. You can lodge your return online.
who_can_apply: You are employed to hunt deer or other game animals on private property.
what_you_need: Your NSW general game hunting licence number (G-Licence number)
Your security PIN (issued to you with your licence)
The date and time of the harvest
The number and type of animal(s) harvested and seen

how_to_steps.text: Enter your G-Licence number and security PIN.
Follow the prompts to lodge your return.

more_info.text: For help with your security PIN, call the Game Licensing Unit on (02) 6391 3750. You'll need to confirm some personal information before you can be provided with your PIN.
